newsitem.title: UK: UK info technology investment seen rising - survey.
newsitem.headline: UK info technology investment seen rising - survey.

text.p: Investors are expected to increase their stakes in Britain's burgeoning information technology (IT) sector in the next five years, according to a survey published on Monday.

About 80 percent of investors are planning to increase their weighting in IT companies over the next five years, and a similar number had done so in the last five years, the London Stock Exchange/MORI survey showed.
The biggest attraction for investors was the companies' long term positive growth rates, the survey said.
Some 67 percent of investors and 55 percent of IT companies believed the investment climate would continue to improve in the next five year.
The survey questioned 71 senior executives of IT companies and 30 institutional investors.
